string-array.name: aro_changelog_102_highlights
string-array.item: Share artwork-colored song images with Artwork, Soft, and Dark styles.
Open Listening Stats directly from Home; find Changelog in Settings.

string-array.name: aro_changelog_102_improvements
string-array.item: Song lists and artwork show loading skeletons while content arrives.
Updates download in the background with resumable ranges and verified checksums.
Smaller architecture-specific APKs are available alongside universal.

string-array.name: aro_changelog_102_fixes
string-array.item: Listening categories include streamed songs and retain new track metadata.
Share previews fit above their controls in portrait and beside them in landscape.
